[[File:The_Great_Hunt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Great Hunt of 3643 BBY]]
{{Quote|The Great Hunt isn't held for the sake of sport. It's meant to find the best the galaxy has to offer—usually, to handle a task vital to the ''Mando'ade''.|[[Mandalore the Vindicated]]|<ref name="TOR:THoD">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Heart of Darkness|the ''Spirit of Vengeance''}}</ref>}}
The '''Great Hunt''' was a competition for glory that originated among the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] as a test of skill on the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. Over time, the Hunt became an open competition in which any of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] warriors could compete. A total of three Great Hunts were called during the [[Great Galactic War]], and another three were held during the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
Originally a test of skill among the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture on the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], the Great Hunt developed into a competition open to all warriors and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Hedarr Soongh]] was the youngest bounty hunter to ever win a Great Hunt, claiming the title of [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt|Grand Champion]] during a [[Great Hunt (c. 3708 BBY)|Great Hunt]] held around [[3708 BBY]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a total of three Great Hunts were held, and [[Mandalore the Lesser]] called for [[Great Hunt (c. 3653 BBY)|another Hunt]] not long after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]]. The Grand Champion of that Hunt, Artus Lok, challenged Mandalore to a duel and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him, claiming the title of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]]. He would hold another [[Great Hunt (Jewl'a Nightbringer)|Hunt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which was won by [[Jewl'a Nightbringer]], and a [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|third Hunt]] around [[3643 BBY]] that was won by a [[Hunter (individual)|young bounty hunter]]. The [[Defenestrator]], and [[Bloodworthy]] were among the winners of the Hunts during the Great Galactic War, and the third Grand Champion from the war served as [[Huntmaster (Wookiee)|Huntsmaster]] of the most recent Hunt. The Hunts during the Cold War consisted of thirty-two contestants sponsored by various patrons, and the competitors were narrowed down over four rounds. Contestants were only permitted to kill each other if they were competing for the same [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]], and any violations or attempts to rig the odds from the outside resulted in kill-on-sight bounties.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
